role: Prespecified parameter follow-up in the SAME16-school validation cohort, not a second independent cohort.
selection: H2/G12 was named in the primary root design before fresh feeding began. This analysis plan is fixed before any completed paired coarse/fine validation block or fine-grid feeding-effect analysis. No settings are selected using the active cohort's outcomes.
matching: Reuse16 starting schools and labels71001/71002, with NEW H2 dolphin-only, G12-only and H2/G12 mixed encounters. H1 D-only or G36-only outcomes cannot substitute for these controls. Preserve cross-setting school/label pairing.
estimand: For each species, form integer mixed-minus-matched-control capture differences, divide by12 individuals, average the two labels within each school and then average the16 school effects. Nominal36T remains the denominator under coherent early depletion; rates divide by36 separately.

secondary_estimation.interval_role: 95% POINTWISE paired school-mean Student t intervals, not a second confirmatory success family.
secondary_estimation.outputs: All world/school effects and signs, per-individual and group food, school SD/SE, W and conditional repeat MCSE. Coarse and fine-minus-coarse results remain secondary.

bootstrap_sensitivity.unit: Whole-school vectors jointly across labels, species and grids

secondary_estimation.decision_guard: The original H1/G36 primary97.5% intervals and criterion remain unchanged. H2/G12 cannot rescue or replace that primary decision. Report uncertainty and directions rather than an automated secondary pass/fail.

additional_programme_family.execute_only_after: Both complete192-case studies and their independent final audits pass; verify all384 case identities and the same16 school/label vectors.
additional_programme_family.intervals: 98.75% two-sided school-level Student t intervals for the four fine-grid mean effects, Bonferroni approximate95% simultaneous coverage under individual interval assumptions.
additional_programme_family.programme_criterion: All four lower bounds exceed zero for a programme-wide claim that both tested settings benefit both species.
additional_programme_family.preservation: Always retain and report the original primary and secondary estimates/intervals alongside this additional conservative analysis; do not replace a less favourable result or choose whether to compute the family after seeing outcomes.
additional_programme_family.independence: n remains16 school clusters. If any resampling is used in a later programme sensitivity analysis, resample the same complete school vector jointly across both settings and labels; never treat the settings as32 schools.
additional_programme_family.comparison_guard: H1/G36 versus H2/G12 changes BOTH herding duration and bird number. It cannot isolate either factor or establish an optimum.
